cohort.dense_controls: five unique matched dense (one per seed)

states.B: masked initialization actually used for recovery (A * mask)
states.C: direct trained IMP state that selected the mask (.80: round_07, .85: round_08 final_recovered; round_08 is bit-identical to final_s0.80 endpoint)
states.D: diagnostic copy of C with selected mask applied (immediate pruning distortion)
states.E: recovered sparse and same-step dense snapshots

probes.registered: high_sparsity_coupling_v1/probes/seed_S.pt: validation batch 0 (128x128 tokens), 2048 registered positions, full source hidden inputs for capacity
probes.additional_probes: gradient minibatches only (separate from the validation probe)

modes.dense_native: secondary (same dense-native vectors to both experts)

activation_geometry.cka: centered linear CKA, undefined if centered norm zero
activation_geometry.subspace: feature-space R^d primary (centered), sample-space R^N secondary; ranks 8/16/32 each only if <= numerical rank and <= N-1; degenerate cutoff flagged
activation_geometry.precision: fp32 forward, float64 reductions, TF32 off
activation_geometry.aggregation: per layer-expert -> equal-expert mean per layer -> seed; seed is the replication unit

fixed_gate_distortion.gates: softmax prob of selected top-1 expert, capacity-accepted, capacity priority = selected probability over the full batch
references: same-step dense gates (fixed_source and dense_native inputs)
A gates at step 0 == same-step dense at step 0
fixed_gate_distortion.normalization: mean squared norm of reference MoE output under the same frozen gates and reference experts

gradient_geometry.minibatches: 16 per seed: training-loader batches 0,20,...,300 of epoch 1 (batch size 128), same for dense and sparse; selected by index only
gradient_geometry.loss: task = mean token CE; aux = 0.1 * mean load-balance auxiliary loss, separate backward
gradient_geometry.precision: fp32, TF32 off, eval mode, native forward, no optimizer step, no scaler
quantities: uncentered Gram-based subspace overlap r=1,2,4,8 subject to numerical rank

mask_structure.note: nesting overlap .75 is structural; cross-seed overlap is coordinate-based only

connectivity: inventory first; execute only if distinct same-mask same-init endpoints with independent recovery randomness exist; otherwise unavailable
exclusions: no condition selected on recovery outcomes; all ten sparse conditions retained; historical/rerun identical states not independent
compute_estimate: activation ~1-2 min/step/seed on H100; gradient ~3 min/seed; storage ~0.5 GB
precision_note: historical continuation had TF32 off, rerun TF32 on; these diagnostics use TF32 off for all
